author: Levie
basedOn: levels/floor1.ts in /workspace/sunken-keep/levels as of 2026-10-18; regenerate with /workspace/sunken-keep/levels/tools/floor1_decor.py if the map changes
faceConvention: face = the direction a wall face points. The viewer stands on the square next to the wall in that direction (N is y-1, S is y+1, E is x+1, W is x-1). Same as sconces in floor1.ts.
story: Floor 1 is the top floor of a dwarf hold: its gate and guard level. The hold is sinking, so water stains rise from below.

rules.noLight: No decoration or material adds light or is emissive. Tile light is untouched: 0 flips across the 138 squares, tileLight(19,8) stays 0.05848.
rules.darkZones: pell, hook_corridor, lair and stair_room are matte only: nothing pale, glossy or specular. They must look as dark as they do now.
rules.secrets: No decoration on any wall tile within one square (incl. diagonals) of a secret wall (5,1), (5,13). knot_band never within two. The only mark on a secret is its own carving_secret.
rules.doors: Door art stays painted. Only lintel decorations on door tiles; the lair door (19,5) stays plain.
rules.mounts: No decoration on the 11 wall-mount faces (9 sconces, Pell lamp (14,9)W, jar rack (8,10)E).
rules.depth: Nothing sticks out more than 0.05 of a square into a walkable square unless hideNearCamera is true; those join the wall-mount hide list.
rules.purpose: Chains, weapon racks and shield rows only in guard_hall. Clan banners only in muster_hall, antechamber, guard_hall. Set-piece carvings (ancestor faces, beard reliefs, pillars, heraldry, rune lintels, waymarkers) only at doorways, junctions and room ends.
rules.variants: Every wall face gets one of clean, damp, cracked, patched. No face matches its neighbour along the wall or another face seen from the same square (checked: 0 matches).
rules.noFloodCues: Canon: the keep sank into the Mirefen mud but stayed dry inside. No tide lines, water-level stains, salt crust, barnacles or kelp anywhere.
rules.oneStonePerRun: Each room or corridor uses ONE wall family (wallFamily) on both sides; outerShell never changes the stone. Families change only at a door or a room boundary; inside a run only the variant changes. Textures are Artie walls_floor1 files. soot_brick_1 and plaster are unused on floor 1.
rules.swamp: The swamp presses in from outside. outerShell faces (solid rock or mud behind them) get seepage: wet_sheen outside dark zones, matte_dark (darkened, no specular) inside them. swampPressure (0 to 1) per zone scales how many mud-and-root cracks the renderer may add on outerShell faces. Every face gets a thin damp strip at the floor line.
rules.bulge: bulge faces push out at most 0.04 of a square, so they stay under the depth limit.
rules.fire: The fire was paid away: cold braziers, empty forge niches and soot ghost marks where lamps once hung. None of them glow.

zones.name: Gate passage
zones.story: The fortress gate, sealed behind you by the cave-in at (3,14). Heavy carving says you came in through the front door of a dwarf hold.

zones.name: Cistern hall
zones.story: The hold's top cistern, still holding its own water. The swamp presses hardest on this outer corner.

zones.name: Muster hall
zones.story: Where the gate guard assembled. Clan banners under the lit torch at (0,6).

zones.name: Guard antechamber
zones.story: Between the cistern door (4,2) and the guard hall.

zones.name: Guard hall
zones.story: The guard level's main room: racks, shields, chains. Sunbeam at (11,2), fallen beams.

zones.name: Pantry
zones.story: Store room, plain inner brick with patched gaps where shelves were torn out.

zones.name: Hook corridor
zones.story: Dark passage toward the lamp-keeper. Soot starts here.

zones.name: Lamp-keeper's rooms
zones.story: Pell's rooms. floor1Dark: stays dark, matte only.

zones.name: Cellar landing
zones.story: Below the cellar door (6,8), against the outer shell: mud and roots force through the cracks.

zones.name: Slime trail
zones.story: Stone eaten smooth and pitted along the trail.

zones.name: Slime lair
zones.story: Unlit by design. Matte only, nothing pale or glossy.

zones.name: Stair landing
zones.story: The way down to floor 2, deep against the outer shell; cold air from below.
